name: Task Status Cycler
description: Complete Pomodoros while carrying worked-on/deferred links, copying a closed named Pomodoro's name onto the created one, and copying each Task Link sub-bullet's sub-sub-bullets into the linked task's Work Log, toggle empty Pomodoro placeholders/sub-bullets with Ctrl+Alt+] including named placeholders, toggle Obsidian tasks with Ctrl+Shift+] — always prompting for promotion destinations when exact Tasks exists (Enter defaults to Tasks conversion, including in place when already there; typing creates a new section; non-Tasks stays plain; empty non-Tasks source sections are removed) and for demotions from Tasks — cycle Blocked tasks out with option+[/option+], recover affected Blocked dependents, propagate Ctrl+Enter to embedded task transclusions, and preserve embedded-task behavior. Ctrl+Enter on a Task Link closes the linked task and strikes the link, embedded or plain. A versioned `api.recoverBlockedDependents` lets other plugins recover Blocked dependents without retiring references; dependents with a strictly future `scheduled` date stay Blocked, and Ctrl+Enter on a Task Link to a Cancelled task shows a notice instead of completing the owning Pomodoro. Depends-On lines (managed ⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:** child bullets) are never struck, restored, reformatted, or tree-closed: Ctrl+Enter closes or reopens the linked prerequisite only, and Alt+[ / Alt+] cycle the link under the cursor. Ctrl+Enter on the PRE/POST row the bob-navigation-hotkeys review walk just landed on hands off to nav api v2, which completes the row and advances within its group when another live row remains. Alt+[ / Alt+] on a Pomodoro Task Link instead toggles the linked task between Next and In Progress through the nav api.taskLinkLane v1 namespace, never reformatting the bullet. Closing a planned task recovers and links what it unblocked into its slot in the same write — gated on `[id::]`, through open editors or preimage-checked vault writes, honouring `plan.link_unblocked` — and reports it once: the Unblocked card through nav `api.notice` v1, the walk toast on review landings, or a plain notice without nav. Reopening the predecessor the same day through Ctrl+Enter takes back untouched successor links and restores their statuses from an in-memory receipt; Alt+]/Alt+[ moves into Done join the same pass, while moves into Cancelled recover only.
author: Bryan
